summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K, disclosing that on September 30, 2026, its board appointed Mr. Ou Yuyang as an executive director. Mr. Ou brings roughly five years of private fund management, corporate banking and capital markets advisory experience in China, currently serving as Marketing Manager at Lefeng (Hainan) Private Fund Management Co., Ltd. He will not sit on any board committee, has no family relationships with directors or officers, and no related-party transactions require Form 20-F Item 7.B disclosure. There is no deal, price, premium or financial term. Watch for any further board or management changes and related disclosure.
